_why: Gold calls that answer nothing, listed case by case so an empty result is a decision on the record rather than a number nobody reads. Gate 4 fails on any gold-call error, and on any empty or skipped call that is not in this list. `kind` is `single` for benchmarks/ and benchmarks_en/ and `multiturn` for benchmarks_multiturn/ and benchmarks_multiturn_en/, because the two languages carry the same gold. Written 2026-09-16 against platform commit 1309117 and the WS-D/WS-E/WS-G data.
